$comment: Safehouses and garages, by the wave each ships (docs/design.md, Progression and economy). A safehouse gives save, sleep (full runway) and a wardrobe, plus a garage where listed; a garage gives save and car repair. Positions are street locations, never addresses, and no copy jokes about rent or neighbourhoods.
source: Hand-traced from DataSF street-centerline intersections (3psu-pn9h, read from the wave-2 road graph); approximate, a game boundary, not an official one.

sites.label: The FiDi coworking desk, Montgomery St
sites.blurb: A hot desk, a locker for your stuff and a nap pod booked in fifteen-minute slots.

sites.label: The Marina garage, east end of Marina Blvd at Laguna St
sites.blurb: Save, repair, and a view of the fog arriving on schedule.

sites.label: The Mission Bay garage, Mission Bay Blvd near 4th St
sites.blurb: Save and repair. The drawbridge is two blocks away; mind the gap.

sites.label: The Russian Hill garage, Hyde St near Union St
sites.blurb: Save and repair, with a handbrake check on the way out.

sites.label: The North Beach studio over a bar (neon beer-sign icon), Columbus Ave
sites.blurb: A studio over a bar. The neon sign is your night light.

sites.label: The Dogpatch warehouse loft, next to the Pier 70 bench
sites.blurb: A loft with a workshop and a garage door wide enough for regret.

sites.label: The Marina flat with a Palace of Fine Arts view
sites.blurb: The listing says sun-drenched. It has never seen the sun.

sites.label: The Presidio garage, near the Main Post
sites.blurb: Save and repair among the eucalyptus.

sites.label: The Hayes Valley micro-unit, near Octavia Blvd
sites.blurb: Small, bright, and the bed folds into the wall with a sigh.

sites.label: The Mission flat
sites.blurb: A flat with a burrito-shaped dent in the couch.

sites.label: The Potrero Hill garage
sites.blurb: Save and repair, halfway up a hill that never ends.
